observed_reality.vercel_description: Deployment rate limited — retry in 24 hours.

architecture_delta.mechanism: Build-internal preview runner stages a credential-free shallow exact-HEAD Git repository, verifies exact commit/clean index/no remote, provisions toolchain before network deny-all, and runs the EntityOS matrix in one Vercel Sandbox.
architecture_delta.pristine_freeze_source: Component regressions execute in /vercel/sandbox/src; canonical one-file freeze unpacks the exact source archive again into /vercel/sandbox/buildsrc and re-verifies HEAD, clean index, no remote and no ignored artifacts before invoking build_canonical_onefile.py.
architecture_delta.security_boundary: Does not restore repository-static HTTP sandbox execution; main BUILD_INTERNAL_ONLY endpoint remains untouched.
architecture_delta.deduplication: Per-deployment sentinel prevents a second Sandbox start when Vercel invokes the build hook twice.

alternatives_considered.name: committed-tree archive without Git metadata
alternatives_considered.reason: Current canonical EntityOS builder requires exact Git HEAD and clean worktree provenance.

alternatives_considered.name: external snapshot attestation accepted by builder
alternatives_considered.reason: Would expand the builder trust/authority contract when exact sanitized Git provenance can preserve the existing contract.

alternatives_considered.name: sanitized exact Git provenance with pristine second freeze checkout
alternatives_considered.reason: Preserves existing builder authority and prevents preceding py_compile/unittest caches from contaminating the release freeze source.

single_unusual_experiment.name: ignored-import-artifact provenance blindspot falsifier
single_unusual_experiment.finding: A Git-clean checkout can still contain ignored import-capable artifacts such as __pycache__ bytecode that can influence a Python freeze. The EntityOS builder now fails closed on relevant ignored import artifacts.

negative_results: A committed-tree-only Vercel batch reached offline_go_matrix and failed after toolchain provisioning; absence of Git provenance was not sufficient for the hardened canonical builder path.
The exact Batch-3 candidate could not start because Vercel rejected the deployment before build execution due to deployment rate limiting.
Static review found and fixed an unescaped Bash parameter expansion embedded in a JavaScript template literal before any candidate Sandbox run.

forbidden_evidence_excluded.note: Observed REAL_SELF_HOSTED_UBUNTU_EXECUTION receipts are not used for EntityOS promotion under the current sandbox-only directive.

promotion_gate.exact_next_action: When Vercel permits another deployment, execute PR 771 current/rebased exact head in exactly one isolated Vercel Sandbox and require PASS for sanitized exact Git provenance, pristine freeze source, canonical source pipeline, reproducible one-file EntityOS, runtime gates, PATH-without-host-Python, relocation byte identity, DENY_ALL during tests, and clean Sandbox stop.
